title: Phase A — shell lightness
objective: Cold start loads only Auth + MainTabs shell; LiveKit globals deferred to Call; no zombie 5s wallet or Cognito poll; For You snapshot only while For You/Videos focused; FEED_PAGE_SIZE <= 15.
acceptanceCriteria: App.js does not call LiveKit registerGlobals at module load.
Heavy screens (LiveStream, CoinStore, Artillery, battles, rooms) are React.lazy.
HomeScreen has no 5s wallet interval for unused balances.
useCommon auth engine does not setInterval(setFromSession, 5000).
